title: Rook County Emergency Communications District
summary: A consolidated county 911 center (twelve positions, NG911 call delivery over the state ESInet, a CAD on the county domain, a five-site P25 radio system and a backup PSAP) and a tabletop exercise generated from its simulated plans: a telephony denial-of-service flood and CAD malware during a tornado warning, with swatting calls.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Rook County, its 911 center, people, agencies, products and identifiers are simulated; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/county-911/SOURCES.md.

scenarios.title: Silent Calls
scenarios.summary: During a tornado warning, a robocall flood ties up the 10-digit lines and then the 911 trunks, RespondCAD starts freezing and showing unit status changes nobody made, and a calm caller reports a hostage situation at a county commissioner's home; the center must go to cards, decide whether to reroute 911 to Tamarack County and tell the public how to reach help.
